result.text:
### Q1
No. The JSON file store stays, because ops runs a nightly rsync that diffs plain-text files, so SQLite or any binary format would break that.

### Q2
Yes, `src/legacy/` must never be modified. It is vendored code that the platform team's sync job overwrites every Monday.

### Q3
The HMAC-SHA256 goes in a top-level `sig` field, as the last key of the JSON body. It is computed over `JSON.stringify(payload)` without `sig`. A signature header was ruled out because the ERP's API gateway strips custom `X-` headers. I don't know whether an earlier attempt was actually tried and failed, beyond that gateway constraint.

### Q4
Port 9911. The docs, the README and `config/default.json` still say 8080.

### Q5
Every new user-facing `message` must be in German, because the warehouse UI shows messages verbatim. The `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Older messages are still English and haven't been translated.

### Q6
Hardcoded Austrian nationwide public holidays for 2026 and 2027 live in `src/services/holidays.ts`, and `isBusinessDay` in `src/services/eta.ts` skips them via `isPublicHoliday`. The deployment is offline, so nothing can be fetched from the network, and no new dependencies are allowed. Years outside 2026–2027 have no holidays, and regional holidays aren't included.

### Q7
No. The ERP answers 422 to array payloads, so only a single event object per request is accepted, and batching was not built.

### Q8
No new npm packages, runtime or dev. Each new package needs a security review of about six weeks.

### Q9
No. The user said ETA caching is a dead end, and no memoization exists in this repo. QA reported stale ETAs from it, which presumably means staging runs a different build or branch. We should ask which one before removing anything.

### Q10
There are up to 3 attempts, 30 s apart, with a fixed delay and no backoff. Network errors, timeouts and 5xx are retried, and 4xx is not. The worst case is about 75 s, which fits inside the ERP's 2-minute `event_id` dedup window. Retries are in memory only, so a restart drops them.

### Q11
The recipient's name, address and phone number must never be logged, for GDPR reasons (the data protection officer flagged it). Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are fine to log.

### Q12
Yes, `emits webhook on delivered` in `test/events.test.ts` (OPS-412, owned by the platform team). If it fails, rerun once and don't fix it.

### Q13
Only ATP numbers are validated, following `docs/carriers.md` with the S10 check digit in `src/lib/s10.ts`. A bad number returns 400 `INVALID_TRACKING_NUMBER` with a German message. Other carriers accept any non-empty value. I don't know the reason for validating ATP only, beyond that `docs/carriers.md` specifies the format.

### Q14
Hot reload has not been built. If it is ever built, use `fs.watchFile` polling. `fs.watch` never fires on the staging Docker bind mount. I don't know of anything else that was tried.

### Q15
Yes, `GET /shipments/:id`. Mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown or missing fields, so it must not change until the mobile team's January release. A test freezes its key set.
